nodes.name: .env.local.example
nodes.summary: Template for local environment variables documenting required secrets (MongoDB URI, NextAuth secret, Google OAuth credentials) and optional supplier-risk intelligence API keys (News API, OpenSanctions, Alpha Vantage).
nodes.languageNotes: Comments annotate free-tier rate limits and signup URLs; several intelligence sources need no key at all.

nodes.name: .yarnrc.yml
nodes.summary: Yarn configuration setting nodeLinker to use a conventional node_modules install layout.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Minimal project readme placeholder for the portfolio website repository.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: NPM manifest for the react-resume-template portfolio app, declaring Next.js 13 scripts (build with --no-lint, dev, lint, sitemap) and a large dependency set spanning MongoDB/Mongoose, NextAuth, Lexical rich-text editing, PDF tooling, MQTT, Google Generative AI, and finance data libraries.
nodes.languageNotes: Broad dependency surface reflects the multi-feature app: pdf-lib/jspdf/react-pdf for e-signing, mqtt for the ESP32 camera feed, yahoo-finance2 for finance, mammoth/xlsx for document import.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript compiler configuration enabling strict mode, unused-locals/parameters checks, and the @/* path alias mapping to ./src, with the Next.js language-service plugin and JSX preserved for the Next compiler.

nodes.name: vercel.json
nodes.summary: Vercel deployment configuration pinning the Next.js framework preset, build command and output directory, and rewriting /api/proxy/* to the Google Generative Language API.
